facts.topic: about LAVAALL who we are what do you do
facts.text: We supply, install, and procure enterprise IT equipment — routers, servers, computers, and fiber optic cabling — for businesses across West Africa. We also sell directly to individual customers.
Enterprise IT Hardware & Business Solutions for B2B Customers.

**Routers & Networking**: Supply and professional installation of enterprise-grade routers, switches, and wireless access points for offices of any size. Includes: Cisco, MikroTik & Ubiquiti routers; Managed & unmanaged switches; Wireless access points & controllers; Firewall & UTM appliances.

**Servers & Infrastructure**: Procurement and deployment of enterprise servers, NAS storage, and full data room setup for mission-critical operations. Includes: Dell PowerEdge rack & tower servers; HP ProLiant server series; NAS & SAN storage systems; Server room build-out & racking.

**Fiber Optic Cabling**: End-to-end fiber optic and structured cabling installations for offices, campuses, warehouses, and industrial facilities. Includes: Single-mode & multi-mode fiber; Cat6 / Cat6A structured cabling; Fiber termination & testing; Cable trays & management systems.

**Computers & Workstations**: Business-grade desktops, laptops, and workstations sourced and configured for corporate environments. Bulk orders welcome. Includes: Dell OptiPlex & Precision desktops; HP ProBook & EliteBook laptops; Lenovo ThinkCentre & ThinkPad; Pre-configured bulk deployments.

**Equipment Procurement**: We source and procure any IT equipment for your company — directly from global distributors and manufacturers at competitive prices. Includes: Global supplier & distributor network; Custom equipment sourcing; Bulk & volume order management; Logistics & last-mile delivery.

**IT Installation & Deployment**: Professional on-site installation and commissioning of all IT infrastructure — from single-office setups to multi-site enterprise rollouts. Includes: On-site project management; Network commissioning & testing; Multi-site & remote deployments; Post-installation support & training.
